answers.moment: When I said I'm straight with families if someone's going downhill, Darren said that's hard, telling families. Then he told me his dad died of a heart attack at sixty-one. He said at the hospital nobody said anything for ages, just people walking about, and he'd rather someone had just told them. He said it quite plainly, not making a big thing of it, and then he sort of moved on and made a joke about Donna getting him off the cider. Mostly. I hadn't expected him to say something that personal, he'd been so jokey about carnival up to then. It's exactly what families tell me afterwards, that the waiting and not knowing is worse. I said sorry, that's young. It is young.
answers.reason: It's what families say. I recognised it.
